legend.subdivisions_per_beat: Rhythmic cards: number of slices in each beat (circle) of the card.
legend.pattern: Rhythmic cards: one array per beat, one entry per slice. 1 = attack, 2 = the previous sound keeps ringing (long-note bars), 0 = silence.
legend.contour: Melodic cards: relative pitch of each point in play order. 0 = lowest; equal numbers = the same note.
legend.layout: Where the drawing sits on the image, for the playhead: x values are fractions of the image width, y values fractions of its height, radius a fraction of the width. Melodic points are in play order; `stroke` numbers the connected line each belongs to.
